Subject: Level edges & interview lenses — Priya Shah (Serving) — pre-brief + materials

Hi team,

We have Priya Shah scheduled for onsite interviews next week for the Senior Serving Engineer role (candidate brief attached via Parker). I want to run a short calibration pre-brief to make sure we are aligned on the role "edges" and the lenses we want each interviewer to use.

Attachments: JD_Senior_Inference_Eng_v2.pdf, eval-template.xlsx

High-level role scope (draft):
- Owner: runtime and inference infra shaping the serving runtime and model rollout behaviors.
- Must-have: production-first latency/throughput tradeoff decisions, kernel/runtime optimization familiarity, and experience driving cross-team rollout policies.
- Nice-to-have: compiler-level optimizations (kernel selection), deep quantization experience.

Leveling expectations (Senior):
- Demonstrates cross-cutting technical leadership on deployment risks and tradeoffs.
- Can architect for multi-tenant serving and articulate cost/latency SLO choices.
- Mentors peers on incident forensic workflows.

Suggested interviewer lenses (please flag if you disagree / want to own a lens):
- System design / architecture (Markus?)
- Runtime performance & memory (Marissa?)
- API/contract & rollout safety (Vanessa — bar-raiser)
- Cross-team influence & mentorship (Aditya)

Ask: please review attached JD and eval-template before EOD and add any "edge cases" you think we should probe. Can everyone make a 30-min pre-brief today at 3:00 PM PT? If not, suggest alternatives.

Candidate logistics: Parker shared that Priya is flexible and prefers morning slots PST, but she can do the full-day schedule. I will not invite Priya to this calibration — this thread is internal only.

Thanks — Soojin

--

Thanks, Soojin — I can join the 3:00 PM pre-brief. Quick thoughts after skimming the JD and eval-template: 

- Role scope: I think we should clarify the balance between "building new runtime features" vs "optimizing existing model-serving paths." Priya's resume hints at deep kernel work; if she leans that way we should test for compilation/quantization depth.
- Level edge for Senior vs Staff: add a scenario where the candidate must choose between a safer rollout (feature flag + gradual traffic) vs a high-performance but higher-risk kernel change. Looking for evidence of tradeoff communication and migration strategy.
- Interview focus tweak: increase weight on end-to-end performance debugging (profiling → fix → verify) in the Runtime performance lens.

Proposed live question (to borrow if helpful): present a serving path with cold-start latency spikes under burst traffic and ask them to propose stepwise mitigations with cost estimates.

On the scheduler: I can take System design and the cold-start mitigation scenario.

Onward — M.

Thanks for pulling this together, Soojin. I updated the eval-template with three concrete redlines and a short interviewer rubric — attaching eval-template-updated.xlsx.

Top edits / redlines (summary):
1) Autonomy on system-level tradeoffs — must show independent framing of tradeoffs and a clear plan for communicating with product/infra. If this is fuzzy, lean down.
2) Consistent debugging signal — candidate should be able to name specific tools/processes (e.g., perf trace, async stack sampling, KV cache behavior) and outline an incident postmortem plan.
3) Mentoring and cross-team influence — look for examples where they pushed a rollout strategy and convinced at least one stakeholder to adopt it.

I also moved the weighting: System Design 30%, Runtime Perf 30%, Rollout Safety 20%, Mentorship 20%. If you think that over-indexes system design, call it out.

Suggested probe question for Runtime Perf interview (copyable):
- "You're seeing a 2x latency regression when sequence lengths increase by 3x for a particular model. Walk me through your investigation steps, the metrics you'd capture, the possible root causes, and one low-risk mitigation you could implement immediately."

I can take the API/contract & rollout safety lens in the onsite. I attached the updated rubric.

Attachments: eval-template-updated.xlsx

Vanessa

- Agenda (attached pre-brief-agenda.docx / Drive link above): 10m role + leveling edges, 10m lens assignments & key questions, 10m redlines & pass/fail signals.
